prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: pale cyan. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: a cutout map shape; a torn-paper arrow.
Opens on the bound block, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip is covered as the bound block flattens into a cutout map shape; a torn-paper arrow enters, points into it and stops.
Ends holding on the map shape.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "$77B BRAZIL".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "$77B BRAZIL". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market is the diversification play.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage with a refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a pale cyan flat block-color paper ground. In the upper third of the frame, a cream-colored paper chip with an extra-bold black sans-serif headline "4 BUSINESSES" is visible. In the center, a bound block of black-and-white halftone photographic paper is held together by two intersecting cream-colored matte paper tape strips. The lighting comes consistently from the upper left, casting small, soft shadows beneath every paper layer. Immediately upon the first frame, a new cream-colored paper chip slides in from the top, covering the previous headline; it features the stable, clean, and legible black text "$77B BRAZIL". Simultaneously, the bound block in the center quickly flattens and transforms into a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout map shape of Brazil, characterized by rough white torn-paper edges and a matte printed finish. As the map settles, a small, torn-paper arrow cutout in a contrasting cream color enters the frame with a fast motion and a slight overshoot, pointing directly into the center of the map before coming to a stable stop. The camera remains a Static Shot throughout. The final two seconds hold on this composition, with a very subtle, slow-looping shift in the paper's position to maintain a sense of life. A narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural tone and a brisk but unhurried pace, speaks from an off-screen voiceover while the on-screen elements move: <d>[English] Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market is the diversification play.</d>
